raw_text: r/india — Manipur is on fire and nobody seems to care. The violence between Meitei and Kuki communities has been building for weeks over the Scheduled Tribe status issue. Today it exploded after a tribal solidarity march in Churachandpur turned violent. There are reports of villages being burned on both sides, mob attacks with firearms, and complete breakdown of law and order. Internet has been cut. Army columns are reportedly moving but haven't reached the worst-hit areas yet. The state government seems completely paralyzed. This is a humanitarian crisis unfolding in real time.
